review_question: Extract every source-reported glenoid positioning summary from the supplied primary reports without forcing semantically different measures into a common effect.

pico.population: Human patients or human cadaver shoulders undergoing anatomic or reverse shoulder arthroplasty
pico.intervention_or_exposure: Surgical navigation, patient-specific instruments, or standard instrumentation
pico.comparator: Any reported comparator, or none for a single-arm report
pico.outcome: Glenoid version, inclination or tilt, and offset or starting-point position

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Capture every overall or explicitly labelled subgroup summary with a reported n, mean and SD; retain outcome axis and measurement semantics.
